technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong short-term momentum (three white soldiers, supertrend, hull) but undermined by price below intermediate/long-term moving averages and negative money flow; moderate swing entry with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 72 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Weak sell signal from junior representative with small transaction amounts; broad market sentiment neutral with no contrarian opportunity; insufficient news data to confirm or contradict setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (185.76) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 72 days adds event risk; falling DXY provides minor offset for multinational STZ but insufficient to overcome systemic risk environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + supertrend bullish + hull bullish + force index cross-up show strong short-term momentum setup with price near support (207.72), offering defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages (EMA50, SMA50, SMA200), negative money flow (CMF), overbought stochastics, VIX crisis levels (185.76), inverted yield curve, earnings risk in 72 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create a high-probability mean-reversion trap in a recessionary macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Three white soldiers + supertrend bullish offer short-term momentum setup at support, but this is severely undermined by price below all major moving averages, negative money flow, and zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (185.76), inverted yield curve signaling recession, and earnings event in 72 days create systemic mean-reversion risk that outweighs short-term technical setup; price likely to fail below support in macro stress environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 39 positions in Consumer Staples sector; adding STZ increases concentration risk in low-conviction, high-macro-risk environment without offsetting fundamental or smart money support.
